concept.title: The Saltglass Conservatory
concept.description: A portrait set following one heroine through a misted seaside glasshouse and its adjoining tide gardens, bound by sea-glass teal, tarnished brass, muted plum, and the hush of the blue hour.
concept.heroine: Adult woman, 25 years old, warm olive skin, heart-shaped face, amber eyes, a small beauty mark below her left eye, slender build, long raven-black hair with one silver streak.
